## Why This Is Asked

- Purview lineage

## Code Example
```sql
-- Example upsert for dim_customer
MERGE INTO dw.dim_customer AS d
USING staging.dim_customer AS s
ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET d.name = s.name, d.email = s.email
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (customer_id, name, email) VALUES (s.customer_id, s.name, s.email);

-- Example upsert for fact_sales
MERGE INTO dw.fact_sales AS f
USING staging.fact_sales AS s
ON f.sale_id = s.sale_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET f.amount = s.amount, f.sale_date = s.sale_date
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (sale_id, amount, sale_date) VALUES (s.sale_id, s.amount, s.sale_date);
```

## Code Example

# PySpark pseudo
bronze = (spark.readStream.format('eventhubs').options(**ehConf).load())
# parse, then write bronze
